thesis: XPEL (Nasdaq: XPEL). Q3 2026 10-Q (filed 2026-11-06) read. Q3 revenue 137.8M (+9.9%), 9M 398.2M (+12.5%); operating income 9M 57.3M (+21.5%); 9M NI attributable 44.7M (+18%). China revenue +66% 9M. Q3 includes 4.6M tariff cash recovery credited to COGS. 9M OCF 59.3M; PP&E purchases 76.7M incl about 60.4M San Antonio properties (funded by 44.8M term loan); debt 44.4M vs cash 45.7M. Close 38.12 (2026-11-20) x 27,516,898 = 1.05B = 18.0x TTM NI 58.1M; reported TTM FCF negative (-15.8M); about 4.2% on own estimate excluding the property purchase. Buybacks 5.9M at avg 46.34.
counterthesis: Part of recent profit growth is tariff recovery; reported FCF is negative after the property purchase and leverage rose from zero; China growth and acquisitions drive revenue; inventory of 132M is large against 45.7M cash; stock traded above 46 earlier in the year so price weakness may reflect real concerns not yet read.
invalidation: Downgrade if China/Asia growth stalls, tariff costs return, inventory builds without sales, or the new facilities fail to lower costs.
